architectureDecisions: D1 Emit a binary patch for review plus an incremental v2 bundle to retain exact SHA-1 commit objects; patch replay alone preserves tree, not commit. SHA-only is not portable. Use full ancestor base history; no external repository/framework adoption.

D2 Create a private named ref only in a temporary bare exporter whose alternates read source objects. Bundle that ref excluding base. Never update source refs/config; published objects must survive exporter/source deletion.

D3 Normalize independently pinned BB-127 acceptance as PLANNED_CONTRACT. Bind all subject/evaluator/config/result/log bytes; omit prompt/env/transcripts/backend objects. Existing QA output is bounded summary only, with original-stream digests labelled separately.

D4 Opt in with reviewOutputDir/--review-out. Write private sibling staging under external output root, validate and sync all bytes, rename to manifest digest, sync parent, then clean QA/recovery. Use exclusive publisher lock and fail rather than overwrite corrupt existing output.

D5 Reviewer supplies clean complete base checkout and external manifest/evaluator/config pins. Verify before import, fetch only declared transport ref, detach exact candidate and assert tree, then explicitly rerun trusted standalone evaluator. Exported PASS is historical; replay makes a fresh candidate-bound record.

D6 Stream binary outputs with bounded quotas/timeouts. Fail on overflow, no object/patch/evaluator truncation. Use arg arrays and shell:false. Complete external acceptance logs required; existing QA summary is never substituted for full logs.

D7 Common fresh/resumed finalizer exports during QA checkout lifetime. On requested export failure return REVIEW_EXPORT_FAILED/nonzero/no bundle; clean owned stages and retain matching recovery. Without recovery no retry retention promised. Unrequested legacy status/result stays compatible.

D8 Same commit as base uses BASE_ONLY/empty patch/no bundle; same tree with different commit still bundles. Reject nonancestor/shallow/missing base, gitlinks/LFS pointers, non-UTF8 filenames, unsafe output and unsupported object format. Parse UTF-8 path records with NUL delimiters.

D9 Artifact export is local review handoff, no SCM/value/release authority. Hashes provide integrity against operator pins, not signatures. Exact objects can include committed sensitive bytes; no redaction while claiming unchanged identity. Evaluators are trusted local processes.

Export before QA dispose; recovery dispose only after success. Return REVIEW_EXPORT_FAILED on requested failure; commandDeliver forwards option; unrequested behavior unchanged.

Require all pins; review explicitly executes evaluator. JSON output; exit0 PASS, 64 malformed arguments, 1 replay/export failure. No agent/provider/push.

Delete source/exporter before replay; assert exact commit/tree/binary/modes/deletion/special paths. Snapshot source and instrument cleanup order, CLI, retry/limits/collisions.

gitRecipe: Resolve commits/trees; SHA-1 format, ancestor check, full nonshallow base required. Detect unsupported tree modes/LFS pointers. Temporary bare exporter uses source rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path objects, private alternates and update-ref refs/heads/review-candidate candidateSha.

bundle create --version=2 <stage>/candidate.bundle refs/heads/review-candidate ^<baseSha>. Require exactly candidate/ref from list-heads; parse prerequisite IDs, require each prerequisite ancestor of base and complete in base-only verifier. Record actual frontier, never infer only one from baseSha.
diff --binary --full-index --no-ext-diff --no-textconv --no-renames baseSha candidateSha -- streamed to patch. diff --name-status -z --no-renames parsed status/path records.

Before publication verify/import bundle in independent temporary base-only repo with complete base objects and no source/export alternates, fsck and compare commit/tree. BASE_ONLY skips bundle and requires empty patch; different commit/equal tree still bundles.
reviewBundle.publication: Validate nonempty outputRoot before agent spawn; realpath existing parents, require private POSIX local output outside source worktree/Git common dir/recovery/Backend/QA scratch, reject containment in either direction and symlink components. Exclusive .review-export.lock serializes publishers; existing lock means OUTPUT_BUSY/manual stale-lock recovery. Own random .stage-* mode0700/files0600 with exclusive creation. Await write+file sync+stage sync and byte verification; under lock rename to digest directory without overwrite, sync parent before returning EXPORTED. Existing exact output must fully revalidate to reuse; corrupt collision fails unchanged. Post-rename sync failure returns failure while retaining complete final artifact. Remove only own lock/staging/exporter.

limits.policy: Positive integer overrides may lower caps only; no CLI tuning in this task. Stream bytes/hash/count, shell:false; kill process group and await close on overflow/timeout, clean partial stages. Never advertise incomplete external acceptance logs as complete.

reviewBundle.lifecycle: Fresh and ACCEPTED-handle finalizers export after QA/protected PASS inside QA try before finally disposal. Success adds reviewBundle {version,directory,manifestSha256,status:EXPORTED} only if requested, then disposes matching recovery. Failure returns REVIEW_EXPORT_FAILED/reason/code/backendSha/sanitized QA/reviewBundle:null; retain matching recovery. Always remove owned QA scratch; without recovery no retry retention promised. Failed QA/exhausted/unavailable exports nothing. Keep local claimBoundary.

replay.api: replayReviewBundle({bundleDirectory,repositoryRoot,expectedManifestSha256,expectedEvaluatorSha256,expectedConfigSha256,executeEvaluator:false|true}). Default validates/imports, returns NOT_EVALUATED; explicit true (review CLI) executes and returns fresh subject-bound PASS/REPLAY_FAILED with stdout/stderr digests.
sixSteps: 1. Fresh reviewer clone at exact base with caller-supplied dependencies: require clean index/worktree, full prerequisites, SHA-1. Check externally supplied pins, manifest schema/quotas and all file byte hashes before import/spawn.
2. Inspect patch/paths/historical results. bundle verify/list-heads and prerequisite frontier must match manifest. BASE_ONLY requires same commit/tree and empty patch/no bundle.
3. Fetch declared ref with --no-tags into refs/heads/review/<manifestSha256>; refuse existing different target ref, reuse exact only. No source access or agent conversation.
4. Detach at candidateSha without force/reset of edits; disable hooks/external checkout filters. Assert HEAD, tree and NUL changed-path records against manifest.

5. Rehash evaluator/config; use process.execPath, explicit evaluator/candidate root plus pinned config args, shell:false/timeout and bounded complete logs. Explicit trusted local execution only, no sandbox or automatic installation.

6. Require exit0, unchanged HEAD/tree/status and receipt subject; write separate replay record. Timeout/nonzero/missing prerequisite/mutation/overflow never inherits historical PASS. Patch-only comparison may prove tree, not commit.
replay.trust: Expected digests come from operator result/independent review, never the same untrusted manifest. Integrity is not signature/authorship. Standalone evaluator/config profile only; caller supplies declared runtime dependencies. Artifact symlinks refused; Git candidate symlinks preserved as objects and never followed during export.
replay.support: POSIX local filesystem, complete ancestor base, native SHA-1, UTF-8 names including tabs/newlines, binary files/modes/deletion/safe candidate symlinks. Reject gitlinks (ls-tree -r -z mode160000), LFS pointer blobs (standard version prefix), shallow graph/nonancestor and unsupported object format; no claim of LFS/submodule runtime replay.
